caption: A puck slides across a frozen pond, and a faint reflection slides beneath it on the ice.

sa.check: A puck slides across a frozen pond.
A reflection slides beneath it on the ice.

pc.expect: The reflection moves with the puck and disappears where the ice is scratched or snow-covered.
pc.fail: It stays still while the puck slides; or shows on snow; or lags.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted, dim, and joined at the puck's contact with the ice.
pc.fail: It is upright; or brighter than the puck; or detached.

pc.expect: The puck slides straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It curves; or speeds up; or restarts.

pc.expect: The ice is rigid: the reflection is undistorted.
pc.fail: The ice ripples; or the reflection warps; or the puck sinks.
A second puck appears; or the reflection rises off the ice; or the puck vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The puck and the pond stay the same.
pc.fail: The puck changes colour; or the pond changes; or the snow patches move.
